description: Source code for the LocalElasticAgent class implementing host-local worker management in PyTorch Elastic, including watchdog and health check setup, environment configuration, and process control.

classes.name: LocalElasticAgent
classes.description: Implements a host-local elastic agent managing worker processes, watchdog, and health checks.

methods.name: _setup_local_watchdog
methods.description: Configures and starts a file timer watchdog based on environment variables.

methods.name: _setup_healthcheck
methods.description: Sets up a health check server if the relevant environment variable is set.

methods.name: _log_watchdog_event
methods.description: Logs watchdog events with metadata including worker and request info.

methods.name: _start_workers
methods.description: Starts worker processes with environment setup, watchdog, and health check configuration.

methods.name: _shutdown
methods.description: Stops watchdog, health check server, and closes process context.

methods.name: _monitor_workers
methods.description: Monitors worker processes, returning their run status.
